integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic live-action macro photography. A tiny iridescent emerald-green hummingbird hovers in midair in front of a vivid crimson hibiscus flower in a lush tropical garden just after rainfall. Its wings beat rapidly, creating natural motion blur while its head and body remain sharply focused. Tiny water droplets cling to the flower petals and catch the soft golden morning sunlight. The hummingbird gently extends its slender beak into the flower, feeds briefly, then pulls back and flies smoothly upward out of the frame. The camera performs a slow, subtle push-in toward the bird and flower, maintaining precise focus on the bird's eye and iridescent feather details. Shallow depth of field, realistic natural lighting, rich but lifelike colors, highly detailed feather textures, physically accurate movement, seamless continuous shot.

overall_soundscape: Soft tropical garden ambience with distant birdsong and a gentle breeze moving through wet leaves. Delicate wing beats are audible as the hummingbird hovers, accompanied by a few subtle water droplets falling from the flower.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
